<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def pix(L,ch): return sorted((i,j) for i in range(len(L)) for j in range(len(L[i])) if L[i][j]==ch)
cur = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
Y = set(p for p in pix(cur,'Y') if 0<p[0]<63 and 0<p[1]<63)
C = set(p for p in pix(cur,'c') if 0<p[0]<63 and 0<p[1]<63)
# check yellow == charcoal shifted +24 rows
shift = set((i+24,j) for i,j in C)
print("yellow matches charcoal+24:", Y==shift)
# probe: SPACE then DOWN
r1 = action(['SPACE'])
b = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
W1 = [p for p in pix(b,'W') if 0<p[0]<63 and 0<p[1]<63]
print("dots after SPACE:", W1[:4], "... n=", len(W1))
r2 = action(['DOWN'])
a = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
C2 = set(p for p in pix(a,'c') if 0<p[0]<63 and 0<p[1]<63)
B2 = set(p for p in pix(a,'B') if 0<p[0]<63 and 0<p[1]<63 and not (p[0]==1 and p[1]==63))
def rng(s):
    rs=[p[0] for p in s]; cs=[p[1] for p in s]
    return (len(s),min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
print("charcoal now:", rng(C2))
print("black now:", rng(B2))
print("last result:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
